Welcome to this charming single-story home in Menifee, featuring 3 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms, approximately 1,398 square feet of comfortable living space, solar panels, no HOA, low tax rate area and no age restrictions. From the moment you arrive, you’ll appreciate the inviting curb appeal and beautifully designed, low-maintenance landscaping. The front yard features decomposed granite, decorative rock, thoughtfully placed plants, and charming landscape lighting. A cozy front porch offers the perfect place to enjoy your morning coffee or take in the evening sunset.

Inside, the bright and welcoming living room features warm wood-look laminate flooring, crisp white walls, recessed lighting, ceiling fans, and an abundance of natural light. The living room flows naturally into the dining area, creating an open and comfortable setting for everyday living and entertaining. Just beyond, the kitchen offers tile flooring, upgraded granite countertops, stainless-steel appliances, recessed lighting, and plenty of natural light from the surrounding windows and sliding glass doors.

Down the hallway, a separate indoor laundry room provides added convenience and direct access to the garage. The spacious secondary bedrooms feature carpeting, while the primary suite includes a private en-suite bathroom and vaulted ceilings that create an open and airy feel. Recessed lighting and ceiling fans throughout add comfort and a modern touch.

The home also features a newer water heater and a dual-variable HVAC system installed about seven years ago, along with an attic fan for additional energy efficiency, whole house water softener. The leased solar system is grandfathered into a NEM program, and according to the seller, they have not had to pay an annual electricity bill in years. A Ring doorbell and garage camera will also remain with the property.

The backyard is designed for easy Southern California living with updated, low-maintenance landscaping featuring decomposed granite and decorative rock. An extra-large, partially covered patio complete with ceiling fans and lighting creates a comfortable space for relaxing, dining outdoors, or entertaining guests without the upkeep of a traditional yard.

An elementary school is located just minutes down the street, adding everyday convenience. Best of all, the property is not located within an HOA, yet the neighborhood offers a beautifully maintained atmosphere with noticeable pride of ownership throughout.

At the heart of the home is an expansive gourmet kitchen with SS appliances, granite countertops,  a "hands-free" faucet, large island with pendant lighting, two pantries and double ovens - perfect for large gatherings. The spacious living room features a gas fireplace and the formal dining room flows seamlessly throughout the great room and offers uncompromising comfort. Home includes 3 bedrooms PLUS a versatile room that could be used as a bedroom, den or office. The Primary Suite serves as a private retreat, offering a spa-inspired bath with dual sinks, large soaking tub, walk in shower, barn doors and a generous walk in closet.  Additional large guest bathroom with dual sinks and 2 large guest bedrooms. The private back yard is a relaxing oasis with a patio, alumawood patio cover with lighting and a ceiling fan, a newer saltwater spa for a relaxing soak after work and lush green grass! Other great features include plantation shutters throughout, a sizable 3-car garage w/overhead storage racks, tankless water heater, epoxy coating in garage, rain gutters and solar panels for extra energy savings with bird-proofing around it to keep it clean! This amazing home is a very short walk from a beautiful park with play structures, basketball court and BBQ/picnic area. Life at The Lakes is a daily escape that provides you with exclusive access to walking trails, three lakes stocked with fish, two resort-caliber swimming pools, a rejuvenating spa, splash pad, water slides, state of the art fitness center, club house and meeting room. Centrally located near schools, Mt San Jacinto College, shopping and freeways, this house is more than a home, it’s a lifestyle!

results.remarks: PROFESSIONAL PHOTOS COMING 9/12/2026. Welcome to this Charming Home located in the Heart of Menifee in the Palmilla On The Greens 55+ Community at Menifee Lakes. Featuring a Lovely Floor Plan that gently sweeps you from room to room. Upon entering the home, you will be met with the Enchanting Living Room, Adorned with a Fireplace, Multiple Windows and a Sliding Glass Door for Ample Light and Access to the Backyard. On the other side of the entry is the Lovely Dining Room that gently whisks you into the Delightful Kitchen. The kitchen has many windows with Custom Coverings, a Quaint Kitchen Nook, Ample Cabinets and Counter Space, Nice Stainless Appliances and the Refrigerator is included. The Large Primary Bedroom features a Sliding Glass Door to the Back Patio and the Primary Bathroom has Dual Sinks in the Vanity. One of the Secondary Bedrooms has a Double-Door Entry and has been used as an Office/Study and Sitting Room, whereas the other Secondary Bedroom has been used as a Guest Bedroom. The Hall Bathroom has a shower/tub combo. The Laundry is in the Hall near the Bathroom and the Washer/Dryer are Included with the house. The Garage has Wall-to-Wall Cabinets and a Work Station. The Menifee Lakes HOA features a 35-Acre man made lake, neighborhood parks, walking trails, and access to the Menifee Lakes Country Club with Rolling Greens, Playable Fairways, more than 100 Strategic Bunkers amidst Beautiful Trees, Waterways, and Meticulous Landscape. The Palmilla HOA includes the Community Pool, Spa, Clubhouse Access, and Trash Pickup.

results.remarks:
***PRICE IMPROVEMENT***LOW TAXES & NO HOA***Welcome to 27620 Connie Way, the best value in Menifee! From location, square footage, amenities and most of all price, this home cannot be beat. Arriving, you'll find a well-manicured lawn with brick planter boxes, an additional parking pad, and a large side yard for storage. The home has an 18-panel solar system to help offset energy costs, which also includes an electrical panel upgrade. It even features an electric vehicle charging port!

Stepping inside, you'll find an inviting living room with plenty of space for your furniture and entertainment arrangements. The family room is centered around a cozy, rock-lined fireplace and features its own sliding glass door, providing additional functionality and beautiful natural light for both the family room and dining area. The kitchen has plenty of counter space and offers granite countertops, a dishwasher, an open pantry, and a laundry area with a window overlooking the backyard.

There is a large mudroom between the kitchen and the master bedroom that can easily be transformed into a study nook or home office. The master suite is incredibly spacious and more than able to accommodate any furniture arrangement. The master bathroom includes a pedestal sink, a shower-tub combo, and a stylish wood accent wall. The other two guest rooms are a wonderful size and share a guest bathroom that also features a pedestal sink and a shower-tub combo. The backyard is a private retreat offering a large grass area and plenty of concrete space for a storage shed, patio furniture, and outdoor entertaining.

Home is close to local restaurants, schools and shopping! It is also a commuter's dream, you can easily drop down Murrieta rd to access Railroad canyon to the 15 freeway or take MCcall and easily access the 215 freeway.

results.remarks:
No HOA | Single-Story Living!

Welcome to 31285 Palomar Road in Menifee, where single-story convenience meets everyday comfort in a community with no HOA restrictions. Situated on a 0.17-acre lot minutes away from Mt. San Jacinto College, Bell Mountain Middle School, and neighborhood parks, this 3-bedroom, 2-bathroom home offers 2,376 square feet of functional living space built in 2004.

From the moment you step inside, you are greeted by an open and connected floor plan that flows seamlessly from the spacious kitchen into the dining area and family room, making it ideal for entertaining and everyday living alike. A cozy fireplace anchors the family room, creating a warm and welcoming gathering space.

The kitchen offers a walk-in pantry and a generous island/breakfast bar, keeping you connected to the main living areas whether you are cooking a weekday dinner or hosting family and friends.The primary suite serves as a peaceful retreat with its own private bathroom. The two additional bedrooms provide flexibility for family, guests, or a home office, giving you the freedom to shape the space around your lifestyle.
Step outside to a well-sized lot with room to personalize and make your own. With no HOA, you have the freedom to add a pool, garden, or simply enjoy the outdoor space however you like.

This is a great opportunity to own a comfortable, move-in ready single-story home in one of Menifee's most convenient and accessible neighborhoods.
